summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that CEO and Chair Dani Reiss established an automatic securities disposition plan (ASDP). The plan permits the sale of up to 350,000 subordinate voting shares (approximately 0.36% of outstanding combined classes) over a 12-month period following a 90-day cooling-off period after the next quarterly filing. Sales will occur at market prices under pre-arranged instructions to an independent agent with no subsequent consultation. This filing is a routine insider trading plan disclosure, not a special situation.
